description: Free LLM API for Python & Node.js: a free-only, lightweight LiteLLM/OpenRouter alternative. One OpenAI-compatible client and local /v1 endpoint over Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, Cloudflare, Mistral, NIM, Z.ai, Cohere & Kilo, with LLM fallback that races slow providers and key rotation. Works with no API keys.
